contractAssessment.3DInformationSheet: September 2025 naming table defines building subtype 01=Tower, 02=Podium; version character changes for model/texture revisions.
contractAssessment.olderB1000: Building polygon layer contains open-sided outlines and its automatic POLY_TYPE is T. This historical layer description explains possible semantic lineage but establishes no source-specific 3D/GIS equivalence.
contractAssessment.currentFSDT: January 2026 v1.1 lists four BuildingBlockType examples separately and describes CSUID T as Tower, P as Podium. This newer explicit specification prevents treating the older layer wording alone as a current type crosswalk.
contractAssessment.revision: Current metadata has monthly revision semantics; DateStamp is record import/modification date and model version is model/texture revision code. Their values do not establish common epoch or direction of source classification change.
contractAssessment.229852: 01 and CSUID T agree, but exact GIS Open-sided differs. No published contract explicitly maps this Open-sided record to subtype01. Retain source-specific interpretation/revision hold.
contractAssessment.270876: 02 explicitly Podium disagrees with exact GIS Tower and CSUID T. No alternate 02 meaning, published successor or exact historical crosswalk found in the bounded evidence.
contractAssessment.whyNoCorrection: The actual primary contracts do not justify a type-equivalence exception. Keep all original classifier and spatial gates unchanged.
contractAssessment.genuineNextEvidence: Provider-maintained exact modelID-to-CSUID/type crosswalk or dated exact revision lineage for these two identifiers, or a corrected provider original model/revision. Near-identical footprint and owner imagery alone cannot resolve this type discrepancy.
